issue_context.title: [HTTP/3] Support on WinHttpHandler
issue_context.body:
Consider enabling H/3 for `WinHttpHandler`, see [`WINHTTP_PROTOCOL_FLAG_HTTP3`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winhttp/option-flags#winhttp_option_enable_http_protocol).

Also find out if it's possible to turn on multiple connections for H/3 (or if it's the same option as for H/2 [`WINHTTP_OPTION_DISABLE_STREAM_QUEUE`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winhttp/option-flags#winhttp_option_disable_stream_queue)) and consider adding `EnableMultipleHttp3Connections` (same as [EnableMultipleHttp2Connections](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.net.http.winhttphandler.enablemultiplehttp2connections?view=net-8.0#system-net-http-winhttphandler-enablemultiplehttp2connections)).
